_doc: Presets of the 'ml' mode (MuPE(ML)): head + coupling + ML vdW. 'default' = alpha_s0_vdw1: head and a_cross chosen by the QM/AMOEBA validation, and ML vdW refitted to QM ligand–water dimers (AMOEBA+ strategy). The other presets remain available by name (--ml-preset NAME; --head/--a-cross override).

alpha_s0.head: v2_final2_alpha_s0
alpha_s0.note: learned α(R) (vacuum); a_cross 0.55 from the joint QM/AMOEBA validation (pNA, trypsin, CK2 A/B; MAE 4.87 kJ/mol; cross-validation 5.11)

noalpha_s1.head: v2_final2_noalpha_s1
noalpha_s1.note: fixed α = 1.10·α_AMOEBA; a_cross 0.57 from the joint validation (MAE 4.83; cross-validation 5.06)

v2_old.head: v2_f128_b3_s0
v2_old.note: previous head (without ML/MM window frames, without α(R))

alpha_s0_a070.head: v2_final2_alpha_s0
alpha_s0_a070.note: NMA a_cross (0.70): overestimates the interaction in CK2 by ~16 kJ/mol

alpha_s0_vdw1.head: v2_final2_alpha_s0
alpha_s0_vdw1.note: alpha_s0 + ML vdW refitted to QM water-dimer curves (ml_vdw_v1.json); fixes the too-short pNA NH2···water hydrogen bond
